_readme: Assumptions behind the preliminary score. Edit and the next update uses them. Calibrate win_pct_of_arv and rehab from real auction results.

win_pct_by_type._note: Conservative: the 75th percentile of what outside buyers paid, as a share of Zillow value, 2026 sales (about 3 in 4 winning bids were at or below this). Tax-lien decrees sell at the opening (upset) price, so 0.
